name: Rural Noir / Desi Crime
description: Gritty, grounded crime thrillers set in the hinterlands (UP/Bihar/Heartland) or dark underbelly of cities.

chapters.title: The Body in the Fields
chapters.description: Discovery of a crime that the local police want to quickly sweep under the rug.

chapters.title: The Reluctant Cop
chapters.description: Introduction of a flawed, cynical investigator who has compromised before.

chapters.title: The Local Bahubali
chapters.description: Encounter with the local politician/don who controls the region.

chapters.title: The Caste Angle
chapters.description: Uncovering how local social hierarchies are blocking the investigation.

chapters.title: The Honest Journalist
chapters.description: Meeting an ally who knows too much and is in danger.

chapters.title: The Cover-Up
chapters.description: Evidence is destroyed; witnesses are intimidated or killed.

chapters.title: The Suspension
chapters.description: The investigator pushes too hard and is officially removed from the case.

chapters.title: Going Rogue
chapters.description: Investigating off the books, utilizing underworld contacts.

chapters.title: The Violent Retaliation
chapters.description: The investigator's family or close ally is targeted.

chapters.title: The Bloody Climax
chapters.description: A raw, unglamorous shootout or confrontation in an isolated location.

chapters.title: The Hollow Victory
chapters.description: The immediate villains are dead, but the system remains unchanged.

chapters.title: The Transfer Order
chapters.description: The investigator is transferred to a punishment posting; life goes on.
